title: Eyes-on-Paper Artist · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Eyes-on-Paper Artist · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a familiar object and give the lead paper and pencil. The lead draws the object using one continuous line without lifting the pencil; others guess. Someone recognizes the object. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Eyes-on-Paper Artist, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
